review.notes: Adversarial package review by Claude (session claude-SOUboG); the package was written by codex-PPV1ZT. Checked against PACKAGE_REVIEW.md, the exemplar form, the seven HabiroNahmSeries packets and the public sources (GSWZ arXiv:2412.04241v2, CGZ 1712.04887v3, GZ 1812.07690v1, Vlasenko-Zwegers 1104.4008, Garoufalidis-Wheeler 2505.19885v1, Zagier's dilogarithm notes, Wagner's thesis). Adversarial pass: about 60 computed claims were recomputed independently with exact rational arithmetic or double-precision numerics, and all hold. They include the radial expansion's leading constant chi^N m^(-N/2) c(Q) G S(0) at orders 1, 3, 5 and 7, the Dedekind-sum phase, the Euler asymptotic, the first coefficients -1/60 and +11/60, all A=3 series, the plethystic L_n, the restricted level coefficient, the first jet, the gamma=5 gluing coefficients, every quartic, cubic and knot certificate, and the Bloch-Wigner values. The README's corrections of printed source formulas were confirmed independently: the GZ B sign, the covolume m^(-N/2), the binomial phase, GSWZ (67), (280) and (290), and GW (182). Fixed in place: (1) duplication: lattice Poisson summation is now consumed from the ThetaSeries roadmap, Layer 1 (TauCetiRoadmap pull request #286), and the current Tau Ceti FiniteQuadraticModule Gauss-sum API is cited for section 7.5; (2) wrong supplier layer numbers: PadicHodgeRegulators 'Layers 1,3,4' became stages D.1, D.3 and D.4; HabiroNumberFields 'Layers 1-2, 6-7' became its package Layers 0-3; HabiroCohomologyFoundations 'Layer 8' became Layers 7 and 9; HabiroRings and ColemanIntegration now use HR.x and L2; QSeries QM.0 is named, and the missing QM.1 (eta multiplier) and ArithmeticKTheory N.6 contracts were added; (3) 16 wrong locators, including the nonexistent 'GSWZ Definition 1.8' (it is Definition 2.8 and (93), p. 26), 'Zagier (29)' (it is (3.7)), 'Vlasenko-Zwegers section 4, pp. 11-18' (it is pp. 15-18) and several GSWZ page slips; (4) form: title capitalisation, five process phrases, the definition name formalNahmSeries, and seven new discriminating Checks for thinly tested definitions; (5) Lean: the layer headers are now module-doc comments, there is a new proved negative example (a nonsymmetric matrix is not formal data), and a new theorem target rationalGaussTaylor_eq_gaussSum states the Gauss-sum meaning of the rational family. lean-check on Suggested.lean exits 0 with 11 sorry-only warnings; intake check-files reports 0 problems. The conditional global comparisons (Gaussian normalisation and regularity, Kummer coefficient identity, full-algebra transfer, product gluing, supplier scalar extension) are stated as explicit roadmap targets, not as gaps, so the package is ready for its draft pull request. Accepted as a roadmap; no statement is claimed to be formalised.
